s: Group the 19 workspaces by department; personal shares and old dev copies become candidates to archive.
One domain per business area, owned by a named business lead with a BI contact.
Naming: "Sales – Analytics", "Sales – Analytics [Dev]", "[Test]" so the stage is always visible.
Roles: 2–3 Admins (BI team + domain owner), Members/Contributors for builders, consumers through apps or audiences.
Pipelines for any workspace with certified or widely used models; personal and test workspaces never feed production reports.
gov-workspace-0.check: Domains with owners, a naming convention, minimal Admins, apps for consumers, pipelines for production content.

s: Criteria: owners (business + technical); documentation (KPI dictionary, descriptions); tests (data, model, security) passing; refresh monitored with team alerts; performance budget met; changes via Git + pipeline; no personal credentials.
Process: owner requests → BI CoE reviews against the checklist → certifier approves; yearly re-review; certification removed if an owner leaves or tests fail for 30 days.
gov-workspace-1.check: One page of criteria plus a short review and removal process.

s: Certified: the shared sales model and the Finance board pack model meet ownership, documentation and reconciliation standards.
Promoted: Marketing's model is maintained and useful to its team; document it before considering certification.
Neither: the copy (fold the measure into the shared model, retire it) and the one-off analysis (personal workspace; delete after the meeting).
